0022600223.text: Brooklyn (2-7, 1-4 on the road, 13th in the East and 6 games back in the Atlantic) visits New Orleans (4-5, 3-3 at home, 11th in the West and 3.5 games back in the Southwest), and both teams are coming off a loss. The Nets are without Egor Demin (leg bruise) and Mikel Brown Jr. (rest), who is averaging 12.9 points and 23.2 minutes per game this season. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1, and their last meeting was a 116-113 Pelicans win in New Orleans on January 14, 2026.
